# Mathematics: Chapter 14 — Probability — Formula Sheet

## Theoretical (Classical) Probability

### Definition
For an experiment where all outcomes are equally likely, the probability of an event $E$ is:

\[
P(E) = \frac{n(E)}{n(S)} = \frac{\text{Number of outcomes favourable to } E}{\text{Total number of possible outcomes of the experiment}}
\]

Where:
- $n(E)$ — Number of favourable outcomes
- $n(S)$ — Total number of outcomes in the sample space $S$

## Fundamental Probability Axioms & Rules

### Range of Probability
For any event $E$:

\[
0 \le P(E) \le 1
\]

- **Impossible Event**: $P(\phi) = 0$
- **Sure / Certain Event**: $P(S) = 1$

### Complementary Events
For any event $E$, its complement $\bar{E}$ (event 'not $E$') satisfies:

\[
P(E) + P(\bar{E}) = 1 \iff P(\bar{E}) = 1 - P(E)
\]

### Sum of Elementary Probabilities
If $E_1, E_2, \dots, E_k$ are all elementary events of an experiment:

\[
\sum_{i=1}^k P(E_i) = P(E_1) + P(E_2) + \dots + P(E_k) = 1
\]

## Standard Probability Sample Spaces

### Standard Playing Cards Reference (52-Card Deck)
Total cards $n(S) = 52$:

| Color (26 each) | Suit (13 each) | Numbered Cards (2–10) | Face Cards (K, Q, J) | Aces |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Black** (26) | Spades (♠, 13) | 9 | 3 | 1 |
| **Black** (26) | Clubs (♣, 13) | 9 | 3 | 1 |
| **Red** (26) | Hearts (♥, 13) | 9 | 3 | 1 |
| **Red** (26) | Diamonds (♦, 13) | 9 | 3 | 1 |
| **Total** | 4 suits | 36 numbered cards | **12 face cards** | 4 aces |

> **Remember:** Face cards consist strictly of Kings (4), Queens (4), and Jacks (4). Aces are not face cards.
